name: Lower Wilds
summary: In eastern Feralas, the road runs west from Thalanaar toward the settlements beyond. Humid forest gives way to the dry canyons of Thousand Needles.

sections.title: The Eastern Frontier
sections.body: At Thalanaar, night elves guard the mountain pass where the road enters Feralas from Thousand Needles. You travel west beneath dense canopies, with ancient treants and native wildlife in the woods around you. Leave the road, and the forest grows perilous.

sections.title: A Contested Highway
sections.body: Travelers, scouts, and couriers use the Lower Wilds road between southern wilderness and eastern territories. Night elves hold Thalanaar at the gateway, while the Horde keeps Camp Mojache further inland. The road carries supplies across southern Kalimdor, though woodland dangers and faction tensions make the journey fraught.

faq.q: Where are the Lower Wilds located?
aliases: how to get to lower wilds
faq.answer: The Lower Wilds stretch across eastern Feralas beside Thousand Needles. From Thalanaar at the mountain pass, the road runs west into the jungle.

faq.q: What creatures live in the Lower Wilds?
faq.answer: Ancient treants and native predatory beasts live among the woods and across the forest floor of the Lower Wilds.

faq.q: Which settlements are close to the Lower Wilds?
faq.answer: Thalanaar sits at the far eastern border, and Camp Mojache lies further west along the road.

faq.q: Is the road through the Lower Wilds safe?
faq.answer: The road is the safest route through the Lower Wilds, but stay alert. Forest beasts, territorial guardians, and faction skirmishes threaten travelers.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler leaving Thousand Needles, you enter Feralas through the Lower Wilds, with Thalanaar at the frontier.
As a Horde messenger or supplier bound for Camp Mojache, you travel the length of the Lower Wilds after descending from the border canyons.
